source_title: KickHouse Announces Sam Alvey Partnership and Signature Boxing Gloves
source_excerpt:
Warbird, Desert Ghost and Night Ops are available now as KickHouse develops a broader line for the veteran fighter
SALT LAKE CITY , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- KickHouse today announced its partnership with professional fighter Smile'N Sam Alvey and the availability of three signature boxing glove designs: Warbird, Desert Ghost, and Night Ops. The current glove collection marks the beginning of a broader product line being developed specifically for Alvey.
On the opportunity to create his own gear, Alvey said: "Of course I said yes, because this is a dream of mine. I am going to be able to create some gear that I have always wanted."
The current signature glove lineup includes:
Available designs: Warbird, Desert Ghost and Night Ops
Availability: Now available through the KickHouse online store
Shop the Sam Alvey signature boxing gloves: https://kickhousegear.com/products/luxe-lte-series-hanger-collection
The broader collection preview includes an additional glove concept, along with shirt and wrap concepts. These previews show the direction for future additions to the line; they are separate from the three glove designs available today. Final details for the additional products remain subject to change.
Alvey is a former MFC champion and was Team Carwin's first selection on The Ultimate Fighter Season 16. He made 24 UFC appearances between 2014 and 2022, competing at middleweight and light heavyweight. In December 2023, he defeated Ross Levine at Karate Combat 43 to become the promotion's inaugural heavyweight world champion.
Alvey is scheduled to fight at BKFC Fight Night Hershey on December 4, 2026, at GIANT Center in Hershey, Pennsylvania. The KickHouse partnership announcement introduces his signature collection ahead of that appearance.
For more information about Alvey and the developing signature line, visit https://kickhousegear.com/pages/sam-alvey .
KickHouse combines coached kickboxing classes with boxing and kickboxing gear sold directly to consumers and through wholesale channels. Its classes help members develop skills while training at their own pace. The brand's product offering includes the Sam Alvey signature boxing gloves, with a broader Alvey collection in development. https://kickhousegear.com/
